split_rule: N01..N40 (200 questions) development; N41..N60 (100 questions) holdout; each question 5 candidates
source: synthetic handcrafted seller-style listings only, not live affiliate responses
preexecution_checks: Unique 300 IDs and normalized query texts
No exact text collision with previously executed 120 questions
0 manually fabricated price-boundary contradictions under explicit cap
No family overlap between development and holdout
12 no-qualifying-product negative controls with zero correct candidates
All 300 inputs present and fully labeled
safety: No production API, no database access, no paid AI calls; global.fetch must be blocked
grading: FAIL if any displayed or saved product contradicts a condition
PASS if at least one correct target appears in top 10 and zero wrong cards appear; report misses separately
PASS with zero displayed/saved when no eligible product exists among supplier candidates
UNVERIFIED is not PASS; label evidence ambiguity must be audited
Never use holdout results to fix code then call retest independent
Do not alter dataset or labels after first evaluation; corrections are separately disclosed
limitations: Templated synthetic listings cannot establish real provider precision
Holdout questions are present in the code repository but source must not be tuned after inspecting them
Two exact correct candidates exist per normal fixture question; zero in negative-control queries
Overall accuracy is candidate-pool-dependent; real supply coverage and costs are unmeasured
